actions.action: Replace destructive timeout with a privacy lock
actions.mechanism: After inactivity, hide the session while retaining selections locally, rather than clearing the visitor's work.
actions.implementation: At 90 seconds, replace all content with a neutral locked screen; stop speech and clear navigation previews. Resume requires the session code.
actions.check: Leave distinctive selections idle: verify they disappear at timeout, remain inaccessible through Back, and return intact after authorized resume.
actions.risk: A visitor change before timeout can still expose visible selections.

actions.action: Provide an anonymous session recovery code
actions.mechanism: A temporary secret lets returning visitors recover work without accounts or identifying information.
actions.implementation: Before ticket selection, let visitors create and verify a masked session code. Rate-limit failed unlocks; reveal neither selections nor code hints.
actions.check: Test recovery using touch, physical controls, and screen reader; wrong codes must never reveal session contents or existence.
actions.risk: Forgotten codes require restarting; observers may capture code entry.

actions.mechanism: A non-destructive warning distinguishes continued reading from inactivity without treating screen-reader playback as visitor presence.
actions.implementation: Before locking, offer a large 'Keep reading' control, also activated by physical Confirm. Preserve reading position; offer a longer timeout with an exposure warning.
actions.check: Compare default and extended timeouts: measure reading interruptions, reconstruction attempts, and seconds selections remain visible after scripted abandonment.
actions.risk: Longer visible intervals increase exposure; extensions must never confirm purchases.

actions.action: Make starting fresh an isolated path
actions.mechanism: A neutral entry screen opens an empty session without exposing or resuming the previous visitor's work.
actions.implementation: Provide 'Start new visit' on the lock screen and an always-visible 'Finish and hide' control. Separate carts, history, speech queues, and form caches.
actions.check: Start a new visit after abandonment; exercise Back, Confirm, screen reader, and payment entry. No previous values should appear.
actions.risk: Hidden recoverable sessions need bounded storage and an explicit expiry policy.

actions.action: Collect personal details only at checkout
actions.mechanism: Keeping identifying information out of browsing reduces what abandonment can expose or require retaining.
actions.implementation: Defer required personal fields until checkout. On lock, discard those fields while preserving ticket selections; require re-entry after resume and suppress spoken summaries.
actions.check: Abandon at every checkout field, then resume or start fresh. Verify ticket recovery without personal-field recovery, autofill, or audible disclosure.
actions.risk: Visitors interrupted during checkout must re-enter details, though not tickets.

actions.action: Keep recovery and confirmation independent of connectivity
actions.mechanism: Local session storage supports offline reading and recovery; an explicit confirmation remains the sole purchase authorization.
actions.implementation: Store encrypted drafts locally with a disclosed expiry exceeding ten minutes. Never queue unconfirmed purchases; disable final confirmation offline if authorization requires connectivity.
actions.check: Disconnect for ten minutes, lock and recover selections, then reconnect. Verify no purchase occurs without explicit confirmation and retries cannot duplicate it.
actions.risk: Offline purchase completion depends on payment capability; draft preservation does not guarantee ticket issuance.
